narr: Severe storms developed across the southeast Wyoming high plains the afternoon of 22 June 2023. Storms produced heavy rain resulting in flash flooding for parts of the plains and a tornado near Chugwater, Wyoming.
ev: Emergency Manager reported roads around Chugwater and southern Platte County flooded and impassable.
Flash flooding reported south of Hawk Springs to south of Yoder to 13 miles southeast of Chugwater.
Niobrara County Emergency Manager reported 3 inches of rain in Manville that flowed east into the Niobrara River that runs into Lusk. Niobrara River in Lusk was out of its banks.
lsr: Water covering sidewalk, street and yard.
Flooding of some roads and some roads are impassable.
Flash flooding continues for Highway 85 and County Roads 28 and 30. Water flowing over roads. Report relayed by Goshen County Emergency Manager.
Phillips COOP station reporting Flash Flooding. Bear Creek out of banks. Spring Run and Bader creeks flooded. County roads washed out and impassable.
Niobrara County Emergency Manager reported 3 inches of rain fell near Manville, west of Lusk. Niobrara River flooded and out of its banks in Lusk.
Niobrara County Emergency Manger reports no flooding in Manville, but still flooding in Lusk.
